arxiv-1512-02777.title: Exploration of CPT violation via time-dependent geometric quantities embedded in neutrino oscillation through fluctuating matter
arxiv-1512-02777.creator: Zisheng Wang, Hui Pan
arxiv-1512-02777.description: Abstract We propose a new approach to explore CPT violation of neutrino oscillations through a fluctuating matter based on time-dependent geometric quantities. By mapping the neutrino oscillations onto a Poincaré sphere structure, we obtain an analytic solution of master equation and further define the geometric quantities, i.e., radius of Poincaré sphere and geometric phase.

arxiv-2102-00034.title: Dynamic imaging using a deep generative SToRM (Gen-SToRM) model
arxiv-2102-00034.creator: Qing Zou, Abdul Haseeb Ahmed, Prashant Nagpal, Stanley Kruger, Mathews Jacob
arxiv-2102-00034.description: Abstract We introduce a generative smoothness regularization on manifolds (SToRM) model for the recovery of dynamic image data from highly undersampled measurements. The model assumes that the images in the dataset are non-linear mappings of low-dimensional latent vectors. We use the deep convolutional neural network (CNN) to represent the non-linear transformation.

arxiv-2103-06334.title: Effects of confinement on the dynamics and correlation scales in active fluids
arxiv-2103-06334.creator: Yi Fan, Kun-Ta Wu, S.Ali Aghvami, Seth Fraden, Kenneth S. Breuer
arxiv-2103-06334.description: Abstract We study the influence of solid boundaries on dynamics and structure of active fluids as the height of the container, z z , changes. Along the varying dimension, the geometry systematically increases, therefore, the confinement ( z z ) transits from “strong confinement”, to “intermediate confinement” and to “weak confinement” (close to ”unconfined”).

arxiv-2204-11204.title: Nematic fluctuations in the non-superconducting iron pnictide BaFe 1.9-x Ni 0.1 Cr x As 2
arxiv-2204-11204.creator: Dongliang Gong, Ming Yi, Meng Wang, Tao Xie, Wenliang Zhang, Sergey Danilkin, Guochu Deng, Xinzhi Liu, Jitae T. Park, Kazuhiko Ikeuchi, Kazuya Kamazawa, Sung-Kwan Mo, Makoto Hashimoto, Donghui Lu, Rui Zhang, Pengcheng Dai, Robert J. Birgeneau, Shiliang Li, Huiqian Luo
arxiv-2204-11204.description: Abstract The main driven force of the electronic nematic phase in iron-based superconductors is still under debate. Here, we report a comprehensive study on the nematic fluctuations in a non-superconducting iron pnictide system BaFe 1.9-x Ni 0.1 Cr x As 2 by electronic transport, angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and inelastic neutron scattering (INS) measurements.

arxiv-2211-05081.creator: M. Bonesini, R. Benocci, R. Bertoni, A. Menegolli, M. Prata, M. Rossella, R. Rossini
arxiv-2211-05081.description: Abstract Compact X-rays detectors made of 1/2" or 1" :LaBr 3 :Ce crystals of cubic shape with SiPM array readout have been developed for the FAMU experiment at RIKEN-RAL. The aim is a precise measurement of the proton Zemach radius with incoming muons. Additional applications may be found in medical physics, such as PET, homeland security and gamma-ray astronomy.

arxiv-2311-18572.title: Overcoming Label Noise for Source-free Unsupervised Video Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2311-18572.creator: Avijit Dasgupta, C. V. Jawahar, Member, IEEE, Karteek Alahari, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2311-18572.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Avijit Dasgupta, C. V. Jawahar, Member, IEEE, Karteek Alahari, Senior Member, IEEE. Despite the progress seen in classification methods, current approaches for handling videos with distribution shifts in source and target domains remain source-dependent as they require access to the source data during the adaptation stage. In this paper, we present a self-training based source-free video domain adaptation approach to address this challenge by bridging the gap between the source and the target domains.

arxiv-2402-10034.title: A Causation-Based Computationally Efficient Strategy for Deploying Lagrangian Drifters to Improve Real-Time State Estimation
arxiv-2402-10034.creator: Erik Bollt, Nan Chen, Stephen Wiggins
arxiv-2402-10034.description: Abstract Summary Deploying Lagrangian drifters that facilitate the state estimation of the underlying flow field within a future time interval is practically important. However, the uncertainty in estimating the flow field prevents using standard deterministic approaches for designing strategies and applying trajectory-wise skill scores to evaluate performance.

arxiv-2504-19517.title: Stokes drag on a sphere in a three-dimensional anisotropic porous medium
arxiv-2504-19517.creator: Andrej Vilfan, Bogdan Cichocki, Jeffrey C. Everts
arxiv-2504-19517.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Andrej Vilfan, Bogdan Cichocki, Jeffrey C. Everts. We study the hydrodynamic drag force exerted on a sphere in a static anisotropic porous medium. This problem is analysed using the Brinkman-Debye-Bueche equations with an axisymmetric shielding (or permeability) tensor. Using the exact Green’s functions for this model fluid within a single-layer boundary element formulation, we numerically compute the friction tensor for a translating sphere subjected to stick boundary conditions. Furthermore, we derive approximate analytical expressions for small anisotropy using the Lorentz reciprocal theorem.

arxiv-2505-13378.title: The SXS Collaboration’s third catalog of binary black hole simulations
arxiv-2505-13378.creator: Mark A. Scheel, Michael Boyle, Keefe Mitman, Nils Deppe, Leo C. Stein, Cristóbal Armaza, Marceline S. Bonilla, Luisa T. arxiv-2505-13378.description: Abstract We present a major update to the Simulating eXtreme Spacetimes (SXS) Collaboration’s catalog of binary black hole simulations. Using highly efficient spectral methods implemented in the Spectral Einstein Code ( SpEC ), we have nearly doubled the total number of binary configurations from 2,018 to 3,756.

arxiv-2506-04975.title: Evaluating Prompt-Driven Chinese Large Language Models: The Influence of Persona Assignment on Stereotypes and Safeguards DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX CCS: Security and privacy Human and societal aspects of security and privacy CCS: Computing methodologies Natural language processing

arxiv-2506-04975.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Geng Liu, Li Feng, Carlo Alberto Bono, SongBo Yang, MengXiao Zhu, Francesco Pierri. Recent research has highlighted that assigning specific personas to large language models (LLMs) can significantly increase harmful content generation. Yet, limited attention has been given to persona-driven toxicity in non-Western contexts, particularly in Chinese-based LLMs. In this paper, we perform a large-scale, systematic analysis of how persona assignment influences refusal behavior and response toxicity in Qwen, a widely-used Chinese language model.

pmc-11415597.title: Comprehensive analysis of lipid nanoparticle formulation and preparation for RNA delivery
pmc-11415597.creator: Md Anamul Haque, Archana Shrestha, Constantinos M Mikelis, George Mattheolabakis
pmc-11415597.description: Nucleic acid-based therapeutics are a common approach that is increasingly popular for a wide spectrum of diseases. Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) are promising delivery carriers that provide RNA stability, with strong transfection efficiency, favorable and tailorable pharmacokinetics, limited toxicity, and established translatability.

pmc-11435793.title: Opacification Kinetics of PLA during Liquid Water Sorption
pmc-11435793.creator: Sara Liparoti, Roberto Pantani, Andrea Ehrmann
pmc-11435793.description: When in contact with water, poly(lactic acid), PLA, undergoes several physical changes. A very evident one is opacification, namely the change from the typical transparent appearance to a white opaque color. This phenomenon is particularly significant for many applications, including packaging, since opacity hinders the possibility of a clear look of the packed goods and also worsens the consumers’ perceptions.

pmc-11739024.title: Improving Bone Health Care and Monitoring of Intellectual Disability Patients on a Low Secure Female Unit
pmc-11739024.creator: Serena Hinze, Rosie England, Ambreen Rashid, Nicole Freeman
pmc-11739024.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Aims To ensure all patients on a low secure female inpatient unit have bone health risk factors assessed, identified and interventions initiated within 3 months of admission.The above to be achieved through creation of a Bone Health proforma, integration of a Bone Health checklist into the Intellectual Disability (ID) Annual Health Check and delivery of bone health education for patients and staff.BackgroundIntellectual Disability has been shown to be associated with poor bone health, osteoporosis and increased fracture risk.

pmc-12532774.title: Efficacy and safety of edaravone dexborneol in acute ischemic stroke: systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12532774.creator: Khaled Moghib, Mahmoud Tarek Hefnawy, Shehab M. Moawad, Izere Salomon, Ahmed Hamdi, Olivier Uwishema, Mostafa Meshref
pmc-12532774.description: BackgroundEdaravone dexborneol represents a novel neuroprotective agent utilized in the treatment of acute ischemic stroke (AIS). Preliminary studies indicate that this combination exhibits enhanced therapeutic effects when compared to the use of edaravone alone. The objective of this study was to assess the efficacy and safety of edaravone dexborneol in the management of AIS.

pmc-12613639.description: common definitions of opioid-free anesthesia (OFA) is “a practice that completely excludes the use of intraoperative systemic, neuraxial, or intracavitary opioids [4].” The OFA cultural paradigm is based on the idea that using opioids as intraoperative analgesics might increase adverse events such as respiratory depression, nausea and vomiting, acute tolerance, hyperalgesia, pain chronification, and subsequent chronic opioid use [5].

pmc-12638171.title: Clinical Experience With the Nontyphoidal Salmonella Vascular Infection (NTSVI) Score in a Resource-Limited Malaysian Tertiary Center
pmc-12638171.creator: Weixiang Koh, Nurulyumni Faraha binti Md Sharizam, Seng Hong Koh, Wei Xuan Tuang, Edmund Liang Chai Ong
pmc-12638171.description: Nontyphoidal Salmonella (NTS) bacteremia is an uncommon but potentially fatal infection that predisposes patients to vascular complications, including infectious aortitis. The Nontyphoidal Salmonella Vascular Infection (NTSVI) Score was developed to estimate this risk, with scores ≥ 1 indicating high risk. We describe the first clinical application of the NTSVI Score in a resource-limited Malaysian tertiary care center.

pmc-12841115.title: Vanillin Beyond Flavor: Therapeutic Potentials and Emerging Applications in Hydrogel-Based Biomaterials
pmc-12841115.creator: Lei Cui, Dong Uk Yang, Jing Liu, Ramya Mathiyalagan, Jong-Hoon Kim, Sathiyamoorthy Subramaniyam, Changbao Chen, Deok-Chun Yang, Ling Li
pmc-12841115.description: Vanillin (4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzaldehyde) is widely recognized for its aromatic flavor and established pharmacological properties, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and anticancer effects. While these biological activities underpin its therapeutic potential, recent advances have expanded the application of vanillin into the field of biomaterials.

pmc-13300978.creator: F Notaristefano, N Johner, J Fitzgerald, G Ditac, M Tetreault-Langlois, R Tixier, K Benali, B Sacristan, J Charton, J Duchateau, T Pambrun, F Sacher, M Haissaguerre, N Derval
pmc-13300978.description: BackgroundPulsed field ablation (PFA) has demonstrated high efficacy and safety for pulmonary vein isolation (PVI). So far single-shot and large footprint devices have been used mainly under general anesthesia to avoid muscle contraction. Recently a focal tip contact force-sensing catheter toggling between radiofrequency (RF) and PF became available and its design may cause less neuro-muscular recruitment.

pmc-13375008.title: Hematological parameters and associated factors among adult patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus attending selected hospitals in Garowe, Puntland, Somalia: A comparative cross-sectional study
pmc-13375008.creator: Mohamud Abshir Musse, Haftu Asmerom, Mesay Arkew, Rajesh Sarkar, Winner Kucha
pmc-13375008.description: BackgroundDiabetes mellitus is characterized by elevated blood glucose levels resulting from inadequate insulin production or ineffective insulin utilization. Type 2 diabetes, the most prevalent form, is associated with alterations in hematological parameters. Notably, there is no evidence addressing hematological parameters and their associated factors among adult patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus in Garowe City.

pmc-13381933.title: Association of pyrazinamide resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis with mutations in rpoB, katG, and inhA genes
pmc-13381933.creator: Kartiki Srivastava, Salman Khan, Rajniti Prasad, Sada Nand Pandey, Shampa Anupurba
pmc-13381933.description: Multidrug-resistant tuberculosis (MDR-TB) is associated with a high rate of treatment failure.
